newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares slip in poor trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares slip in poor trade.

text.p: Poor trade in most stocks pushed Egyptian share prices lower on Tuesday, with only Commercial International Bank (CIB) and Medinet Nasr Housing and Development closing with healthy volumes.
The Capital Market Authority all-share index closed 2.55 points lower at 368.24 points on below-average volume of 40.23 million pounds ($11.85 million).
"There wasn't a lot of movement on the market today," said Moez Bonkheila, account executive at Intercapital brokerage.
"But I'm optimistic. There's lots of cash outside the market that should start moving in now. It can't be more attractive," he told Reuters.
CIB was the day's most active share, trading in more than 7.5 million pounds, but it closed 0.5 pounds lower at 74.5.
"The bank's GDR (global depository receipt) is doing well, so that volume is connected to that. Also, CIB is very attractive at that price," Bonkheila said.
Medinet Nasr Housing came second in the day's list of most active stocks, with shares worth 6.38 million pounds changing hands, but it closed one pound higher at 490.

Bonhkheila said active trade in that stock was probably generated by investor anticipation of Medinet Nasr Housing's forthcoming one-for-one free share offer. The stock market authority approved the share split last month.
Two milling shares flew the flag for that sector, which has just recently started returning to form after poor trade.

Central and West Delta Flour Mills rose one pound to 89 after trade in 3.22 million pounds, while East Delta Flour Mills inched up 0.1 pounds to 70.1 after shares worth 1.63 million pounds changed hands.
Egyptian American Bank also did well, with shares worth 1.47 million pounds changing hands, but it followed the downtrend of many other shares and closed 1.71 pounds lower at 142.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 529 points from 531.72 points and the rarely-traded "closed" firms fell to 265.68 from 267.77.
Out of the 93 shares traded, 36 ended up, 36 fell and 21 were unchanged.
